name: Logo & background upload
faithful: Event Details drop zones for Logo (300x300) and Background (1500x500), plus event-wide form Appearance (colors, typography) and per-portal appearance branding panels.
planned: Event Settings gets logo + background image upload (P1); feeds the CFP form and emails.
gap: Builds event logo/background only; drops the form-wide color/typography and per-portal appearance branding panels.

name: Email themes
faithful: Settings > Email Themes: drag-drop visual wrapper editor (header/footer/colors/layout), locked Standard default plus Plain/Event-Logo starters, {{{content}}} tag; applies to manual sends only.
planned: Bottom-of-P2 stretch: at most a custom HTML/CSS option inside email templates; no visual theme editor.
gap: No drag-drop theme wrapper editor; only raw custom HTML/CSS if reached, and it's lowest-priority bonus.

name: Multi-step builder wizard
faithful: Seven-step wizard: Submission Setup, Welcome, Session/Abstract Info, Participant Info, Payments & Fees, Form Settings, Notifications; completed-step checkmarks; header Save / Copy Link / View Form.
planned: Six working steps with Save/Copy Link/View Form; Payments & Fees step omitted entirely (marked NOT NEEDED).
gap: Drops the Payments & Fees step entirely (six steps versus the original's seven).

name: Participant roles + min/max
faithful: Three core roles (Speaker/Chairperson/Moderator) with per-role min/max, total min/max across roles, custom role labels, and first-match-wins conditional participant-limit overrides.
planned: All three roles (Speaker/Chairperson/Moderator) with per-role min/max (schema: role_*_min/max on forms). Total-across-roles limits, custom role labels, and conditional per-role overrides stay out.
gap: COMMITTED TO REACH per-role min/max (was Speaker-only). Remaining gap: total limits, custom labels, conditional overrides.

name: Question rules (conditional logic)
faithful: Show a target field when a trigger field (Checkbox/Dropdown/Number only) matches a value; single condition, no AND/OR; rule set on the conditional question.
planned: Show field B when field A matches; triggers checkbox/dropdown/number, no AND/OR chaining (P1).
gap: At parity for show/hide questions; the conditional participant-limit and pricing-rule variants are not built.

name: Add custom field + field library
faithful: +Add Field offers Add Section Element / Create Field / Search existing library; Library>Fields CRUD across Contact/Group/Session/Eval tabs, event-vs-global scope, type immutable after save.
planned: Add text/dropdown custom fields, reuse from library, PLUS Fields CRUD in Library with event-vs-global scope (schema: fields.scope) and section header/divider layout elements (in FIELD_TYPE).
gap: COMMITTED TO REACH Fields CRUD + scope + section elements (schema already supports all three; UI-only). Remaining gap: Contact/Group/Eval tab split, type-immutability enforcement.

name: Full field-type catalog
faithful: Roughly fourteen types: text, textarea, wysiwyg, dropdown, checkbox, number, currency, datetime, email, phone, file, countries, languages, user.
planned: Nine types: text, textarea, wysiwyg, dropdown, checkbox, number, date, email, phone (all in FIELD_TYPE, which also carries section_header/divider layout elements). Currency, file, countries, languages, user types stay out.
gap: COMMITTED TO REACH checkbox/number/date (schema-ready, render-only). Remaining: currency, file, countries, languages, user.

name: Admin-notify recipient lists
faithful: Notifications step: two multi-select recipient pickers (new submission vs updated submission) plus editable New Submission Alert and Submission Revision Alert admin templates.
planned: Stubbed pickers in P0; real admin-notify recipient pickers on forms deferred to P1 ('nice to have').
gap: Real pickers deferred to P1; new-vs-updated split and the two alert templates stay thin.

name: Forgot password
faithful: 'Forgot your password?' on the Account step sends a reset-link email from no-reply, landing on a /reset token page to set a new password.
planned: Stub on the demo path in P0; real reset flow plus auth polish arrives in P1.
gap: Stubbed for the demo; the working email-reset flow only lands in P1.

name: Add secondary contact
faithful: '+ Add Secondary Contact' on the participant step adds a helper contact who 'can assist with tasks and communication'.
planned: COMMITTED (P1 #13): + Add Secondary Contact on the participant step — PARTICIPANT_ROLE now carries "secondary"; a secondary contact assists with tasks and communication.
gap: Remaining vs faithful: none material once the affordance ships.

name: File downloads
faithful: Portal Files button opens a widget to view/download organizer-shared files; Resources button shows wiki pages; sample files downloadable on requests.
planned: COMMITTED TO REACH: portal Files list where speakers view/download organizer-shared files (speaker kits, logos, templates) — the files table already models it; one portal route + admin upload. Resources/wiki pages stay OUT (struck).
gap: Remaining vs faithful: Resources wiki pages (explicitly struck) and per-request sample files.

name: Multiple audience portals
faithful: Default People/Exhibitor/Sponsor portals plus custom filter-defined portals, first-match-wins ordering, one-portal-per-contact resolution, and per-portal config and appearance.
planned: One speaker portal (Home/Submissions/Profile/Tasks); CRM, sponsor, and exhibitor portals are explicitly out of scope.
gap: Builds a single speaker portal; no audience segmentation, filter matching, ordering, or sponsor/exhibitor portals.

name: Admin impersonation (View portal as)
faithful: Top-right View Portal > 'View portal as...' searches a contact, shows their assigned portal, and opens it in preview-only mode (tasks viewable, not completable).
planned: COMMITTED TO REACH: 'View portal as...' with per-contact search (a real event has hundreds of contacts) opening that contact's portal in preview-only mode (tasks viewable, not completable), plus Back to Admin Mode. BUILD CONSTRAINT: enforce preview-only ONCE in the shared portal auth helper, never per-route — per-route checks balloon past the P2 #6 slot.
gap: Remaining vs faithful: none material once search + preview-only land.

name: Status set (Pending / Queues / Accepted / Declined / Withdrawn / Draft)
faithful: Five statuses (Pending, Accept Queue, Accepted, Decline Queue, Declined) with queues masking as 'Pending' in the portal, plus Draft (pre-submission), Withdrawn, and category-mapped custom statuses.
planned: Status tabs All/Accepted/Accept Queue/Pending/Decline Queue/Declined/Withdrawn/Drafts with queues masked as Pending in the portal (P0 + P1).
gap: Near-parity on the built-in set; no admin-defined custom statuses mapped to categories.

name: Bulk accept/decline + email send
faithful: Check sessions, bulk Edit status; separately Send Emails with Accept/Decline templates (<=100 per send, choose recipient type), then manually flip queue to final status.
planned: Replicate bulk-select > send Accept/Decline template > flip status, plus a one-click 'accept + send + finalize' improvement (P0).
gap: Core bulk send built; recipient-type granularity and 100-per-send batching simplified, plus a non-parity one-click auto-send.

name: Column preferences (25-field picker)
faithful: Columns panel: Fields/Reporting Fields, search, ~25-item Session Details checklist (Capacity, CEU, Client Session ID...), 'x/25 selected', drag-reorder, Reset to Default, Apply; plus Saved Views.
planned: Deprioritized to bottom of P2 ('skip unless free'); tables ship with a fixed default column set.
gap: Column picker and saved views skipped unless free; admin tables have fixed, non-configurable columns.

name: Per-person participant acceptance
faithful: Each participant confirms/declines each role from the portal (Confirm/Withdraw buttons on Accepted sessions); statuses Pending/Accepted/Declined; admin override; rebrandable pending wording.
planned: Portal Confirm/Withdraw buttons per participant on Accepted sessions, driving participants.acceptance_status (pending/accepted/declined); admin sees per-person status. DESIGNATED FIRST CUT if the deadline bites (weakest of the committed reaches; most UI-touching).
gap: COMMITTED TO REACH the per-person confirm/decline machine (schema-ready via acceptanceStatus). Remaining gap: admin override UI + rebrandable pending wording.

name: Evaluation plans (name, dates, evaluators)
faithful: +Add Plan wizard: Overview (name, instructions, open toggle, Opens/Closes dates), Rounds with scorecards, Evaluators from event users, Assignments; percentage or points scoring.
planned: PLAN-LESS by design: reviewer⇄track routing (reviewerTracks) + 3-state decision (reviews) — there is deliberately NO plan table in the schema, and none can be migrated for from a feature branch. Do not build against a plan entity.
gap: Vs faithful: no plan entity, Opens/Closes dates, rounds, scorecards, or scoring methods (swyx demoted all of it to bonus).

name: Conflict-of-interest abstain
faithful: Scorecard 'Conflict of interest or cannot review' abstain toggle removes the submission from pending count and notifies the admin; admin sets allow/require-reason (free-text or fixed list).
planned: Not in the 3-state (approve/maybe/deny) decision floor; abstain sits in evaluation depth (P2).
gap: Abstain likely folded into the decision states or dropped; no reason capture or admin abstain controls.

name: Evaluation summary metrics
faithful: Summary page: counts of evaluations/sessions/plans/evaluators, highest/lowest session, completion chart, Average Score by Plan, Top 10, Thought-Provoking, Started/In-progress/Complete.
planned: Admin sees a per-submission decision tally (approve/maybe/deny counts); full summary charts are P2 dashboard extras.
gap: Shows per-submission decision tally only; drops the summary dashboard, score charts, and rankings.

name: Conflicts view
faithful: Dedicated Conflicts tab lists overlapping sessions and double-booked participants, each with an Open button to the editor; red dot on cards; recomputes on refresh.
planned: COMMITTED TO REACH: dedicated Conflicts tab listing overlapping sessions + double-booked speakers with Open→editor — same computation as the inline warnings, one list route. At 100+ real sessions a producer works conflicts as a backlog, not one-by-one.
gap: Remaining vs faithful: red-dot card markers and auto-recompute polish.

name: Week / Month / Track views
faithful: Agenda views List, Day, Week, Month, Rooms (plus Conflicts and Embeds tabs); track colors paint Day/Week/Rooms blocks.
planned: P0 floor is List plus Day/Rooms; Week and Track views are P1; Month demoted to bonus.
gap: Floor ships List + Day/Rooms only; Week/Track deferred to P1 and Month dropped to bonus.

name: Public schedule page (/schedule)
faithful: Agenda/Schedule embed: day tabs, track filter, colored track pills, expandable session cards, session-detail modal, deep-linkable sessions (reference wf2025.ai.engineer/schedule).
planned: P2 bonus: a public mobile-friendly /schedule page with session-detail modal, high tiebreaker value.
gap: Planned but P2 bonus; ships only if time remains, not part of the guaranteed core.

name: Speaker gallery page
faithful: Speaker Gallery embed: speakers alphabetically by last name with headshots and details, a search box, and pagination.
planned: P2 bonus: a public /speakers gallery page alongside /schedule.
gap: Bonus-tier; alphabetical sort and pagination parity uncertain; ships only if time allows.

name: Styled-HTML embeds (web component)
faithful: One-line script registering a <sessionboard-embed> web component (shadow DOM), five widget types, async-data fetch, theme/primaryColor/showSearch/extraCss config, and ?sb-*-id deep-link params.
planned: P2 bonus: an embeddable snippet for the schedule/speakers pages.
gap: A basic embed snippet is a stretch; the full web-component, shadow DOM, and config surface won't be matched.

name: iCal / JSON export feeds
faithful: Embed output formats: iCal (all approved sessions as events), JSON, XML, and basic HTML; server cache auto-refreshes every 60 minutes.
planned: Per-speaker .ics on acceptance is P0. OPPORTUNISTIC (not committed): a whole-agenda iCal feed is ~one route once the .ics builder exists — take it if the agenda lands early.
gap: Whole-agenda iCal opportunistic; JSON/XML feeds and the 60-min cache stay bonus-tier.

name: Add-to-calendar on schedule
faithful: Agenda/schedule embed shows an 'Add to Calendar' button on each session-detail modal, toggled by show_add_to_calendar.
planned: Depends on the P2 public schedule page; .ics email attachments on acceptance are the P0 calendar play instead.
gap: The add-to-calendar button rides on the bonus schedule page; not core, unlike the P0 email .ics.

name: File requests (upload → review)
faithful: File Requests: title/type/instructions/sample; user upload enters Pending Feedback; admin approve/deny/revert; one file per request, versioned, stored separately from record; per-request message thread.
planned: COMMITTED TO REACH the approve/deny review core: speaker upload lands as pending_feedback, admin approves or denies triggering re-upload — TASK_STATUS.pending_feedback and files.version already carry the state machine. Message thread and versioning UI stay out.
gap: Remaining vs faithful: per-request message thread, version history UI, sample files.

name: Standalone portal forms
faithful: Portal Forms (distinct from submission forms): Contacts/Groups/Sessions type, 3-page builder, prefill from record data, confirmation email with PDF attached, View Submissions and CSV/XLSX export.
planned: Portal forms attached to tasks (hotel/flight P0) PLUS COMMITTED: admin response viewing — the answers land in taskAssignments.response and the organizer must read them (arrival dates → hotel bookings) or the P0 feature is decorative. One detail route over an existing column.
gap: Remaining vs faithful: Groups type (excluded), PDF-attach confirmation, CSV/XLSX export of responses.

name: Task types (contact / group / submission)
faithful: Task Type targets Contacts, Groups, or Sessions(submission), each with per-portal assignment settings and Assign-By-Filter (up to 3 filters) for session tasks.
planned: Task types Contact/Group/Submission (P1); Group tasks nominal since sponsor/exhibitor modules are out of scope.
gap: Contact and submission tasks built; group tasks are vestigial with the sponsor/exhibitor modules omitted.

name: Email template editor (subject + body)
faithful: Settings > Email Templates list (Name/Subject/Category/Type/Trigger); edit subject and rich body; Type scoping (Groups/Contacts/Sessions), reply-to and CC/BCC, manual vs automatic triggers.
planned: Template editor page (category/type/trigger columns; edit subject/body; manual vs auto) PLUS reply-to per template — real speaker replies must land in the organizer inbox (one field + one send header). CC/BCC and type-scoped merge fields stay out.
gap: COMMITTED TO REACH reply-to. Remaining: CC/BCC config, type-scoped merge-field catalog, unlimited-template depth.

name: Merge tags / personalization
faithful: Type-scoped merge tags: First/Last/Full Name, Email, Job Title, Company, Portal Link, session fields; [PORTAL_LINK] token; theme triple-brace variables.
planned: Templates personalized with core tags (name, portal link, session and decision details).
gap: Supports core tags; no type-scoped catalog or theme-wrapper variables.

name: Email speaker with decision feedback
faithful: [doc-silent] No integrated at-decision compose exists; admins manually Send Emails using Accept/Decline templates, typing feedback into the body, decoupled from the status change.
planned: COMMITTED (was bonus-may-slip): compose + send feedback email while recording the review decision — textarea on the decision UI + existing EmailSender port; exceeds Sessionboard parity.
gap: None vs parity (Sessionboard lacks integrated compose). Committed so it cannot slip.

name: Email history log
faithful: History > Emails audit trail with per-message statuses Delivered/Opened/Clicked/Bounced/Spam/Dropped; campaigns add open/click/bounce metrics.
planned: Admin email history page listing email_outbox rows (to/subject/status/sentAt/error) — one list route over data the port already writes.
gap: COMMITTED TO REACH a per-message delivery log. Remaining gap vs faithful: Opened/Clicked engagement metrics (needs provider webhooks — out).

name: "Today": stat cards + status breakdown
faithful: Today tab: greeting plus days-to-event, stat cards (Submissions, Accepted Speakers, Exhibitors, Sponsors), Submission Status row (Accepted/Pending/Declined/Drafts/Withdrawn), and section tabs.
planned: Greeting + days-to-event, stat cards (Submissions, Accepted Speakers), status breakdown row, recent submissions, per-form progress (P1).
gap: Builds Submissions/Accepted cards and the status row; drops Exhibitors/Sponsors cards (those modules are out of scope).

name: "Also check" alert links
faithful: 'Also check' links, e.g. '1 accepted session still needs a time slot (Agenda)', '3 submissions awaiting a decision (Participants)', '+1 more'.
planned: 'Also check' alert links included on the dashboard Today view (P1).
gap: Near-parity on the core alerts (unscheduled sessions, pending decisions); fewer alert types are seeded.

name: Speaker Tracking dashboard
faithful: Custom dashboard: Accepted Speakers, Outstanding Speaker Tasks, Speaker Confirmation Mix chart, Top Speakers by Outstanding Tasks, with +Add Widget.
planned: Firm req: an outstanding-onboarding-tasks view (counts + per-speaker list); the charted Speaker Tracking widgets are P2 extras.
gap: Builds the firm outstanding-tasks list; the charted Speaker Tracking widget dashboard stays P2 bonus.

name: CSV / XLSX export
faithful: Every module's Options > Export dumps the current view as CSV or Excel; file fields export as hosted URLs; reflects visible columns and filters.
planned: COMMITTED TO REACH: CSV export for submissions + speakers — pure serialization of the queries the list loaders already run (one resource-route branch per list). XLSX and the files bundle stay opportunistic P2.
gap: Remaining vs faithful: XLSX format, per-view column/filter fidelity, download-files bundle.

name: CSV / XLSX import
faithful: Options > Import: generate template, upload, map fields, validate (red cells), submit; update via 'Update record if exists'=TRUE; max 1,000 rows per file.
planned: P2 bonus: CSV/XLSX import for teams migrating off Sessionboard.
gap: Import is bonus-tier; the mapping/validation/update-existing wizard will be thinner if built at all.

name: Public API (Sessionboard-compatible subset)
faithful: 177-operation OpenAPI with x-access-token auth, pagination (25/max 100), response envelopes; full CRUD+search on sessions/speakers/contacts/settings, plus webhooks and OAuth 2.1.
planned: P2 bonus: mirror the core read/search set (sessions, speakers, contacts) with x-access-token, their pagination, and response envelopes.
gap: Read/search subset only; drops all writes, webhooks, OAuth, insights, and roughly 150 other operations.

name: Cloudflare deploy
faithful: [doc-silent] Sessionboard is a closed hosted SaaS; there is no self-hosting or customer deploy story.
planned: Deploy on Cloudflare (Workers) as the committed stack decision, targeting sub-second loads as a scored feature.
gap: No Sessionboard equivalent; we add deployability and speed the hosted original can't match (surpasses parity).

name: Forge hosting mirror
faithful: [doc-silent] No equivalent; Sessionboard is single-vendor hosted with no alternate hosting target.
planned: P2 'very teeny bonus points': mirror the repo on Forge at the end only if trivial.
gap: Lowest-priority bonus, likely skipped; it's a repo mirror, not a second live deployment.

name: Duplicate-contact handling
faithful: Sessionboard dedupes via Unique Contact Settings (allow new info for existing contacts / notify existing contacts) and contact merge tooling in the CRM.
planned: KNOWN GAP — documented, not built: unique(eventId, email) prevents exact-email duplicates, but the same human under two emails becomes two portal identities with divergent tasks/bios; no reassign-participant-to-another-contact affordance.
gap: No merge/reassign tooling; moderate effort, below the committed bar for the deadline. Revisit post-hackathon.
